about_intro: Malidag is an online shopping platform offering a selection of products across categories including fashion, electronics, beauty, home and lifestyle. Our goal is to provide customers with a simple, reliable and convenient way to shop online.
about_what_we_do_1: We make products available to customers through our online store and provide product information, pricing, payment options and delivery information throughout the shopping and checkout process.
about_what_we_do_2: Product availability, pricing and delivery options may vary depending on the customer's delivery country. Relevant information is displayed before an order is completed.
about_mission_1: Our mission is to make online shopping straightforward and accessible by providing a clear shopping experience, convenient payment options and dependable customer support.
about_mission_2: We continue to improve our platform, expand our product selection and develop services that make it easier for customers to discover and purchase products online.
about_payments_1: Malidag supports available payment methods presented during checkout. Depending on the customer's location and the order, these may include credit or debit cards and other supported payment options.
about_payments_2: Payment information and available payment methods are shown during checkout before the customer completes their purchase.
about_delivery_1: We offer delivery to supported destinations. Available products, shipping options, delivery estimates and applicable shipping charges may vary by destination and order.
about_delivery_2: Customers can review the applicable delivery information during the shopping and checkout process.
about_returns_1: We want customers to have clear information about their purchases. Eligibility for returns, cancellations and refunds is governed by our published return and refund policies and any applicable consumer protection laws.
about_support_1: If you have a question about a product, payment, delivery, return or order, our support team is available to assist you.
about_business_1: Malidag operates the Malidag online shopping platform and provides customer support for purchases made through the website.
about_business_2: For additional information about using Malidag, please review our Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy, shipping information, and return and refund policies.

terms_accounts_2: You are responsible for activity performed through your account unless that activity results from circumstances for which you are not responsible. If you believe your account has been accessed without authorization, please contact us promptly.

terms_product_info_2: Product colors and appearance may vary depending on the device or display used to view the website.

terms_pricing_2: If a product is listed at an incorrect price due to an error, we may correct the error before the order is accepted. If payment has already been collected for an order that cannot be fulfilled at the displayed price, the affected amount will be refunded where required.
terms_orders_1: Placing an order is an offer to purchase the selected products. An order is not considered accepted until it has been confirmed or processed by Malidag.
terms_orders_2: We may refuse or cancel an order where reasonably necessary, including in cases involving unavailable products, suspected fraud, payment problems, incorrect pricing, delivery limitations, or violations of these Terms.

terms_payments_2: By submitting payment information, you confirm that you are authorized to use the selected payment method and that the information you provide is accurate.
terms_payments_3: Payments may be processed by third-party payment service providers. Their services may also be subject to their own terms, privacy notices, and security procedures.
terms_shipping_1: Shipping availability, delivery methods, estimated delivery times, and shipping charges depend on the destination, product, and order. Relevant shipping information is provided during the shopping or checkout process where available.
terms_shipping_2: Delivery estimates are estimates only and may be affected by carriers, customs procedures, local conditions, holidays, or other circumstances outside our reasonable control.
terms_returns_1: Eligibility for order cancellations, returns, exchanges, and refunds is governed by our published return and refund policies and by any mandatory consumer rights that apply to the purchase.

refund_intro_1: This Return and Refund Policy explains the conditions under which customers may request a cancellation, return, replacement, or refund for purchases made through Malidag.
refund_intro_2: We want customers to have clear information about their options when an order does not arrive as expected or when a product needs to be returned.
refund_eligibility_1: A product may be eligible for return if the return request is made within the applicable return period and the product meets the conditions described in this policy.
refund_eligibility_2: Unless otherwise stated on the product page or required by applicable law, customers should contact us within 14 days of receiving an order if they wish to request a return.
refund_condition_1: To be eligible for a return, products should generally be unused, unworn, and in substantially the same condition in which they were received, including original packaging where reasonably applicable.
refund_condition_2: We may request photographs or other information when necessary to verify the condition of a product or the reason for the return.
refund_non_returnable_1: Certain products may not be eligible for return for hygiene, safety, personalization, perishability, or other lawful reasons. Any product-specific restrictions should be shown on the relevant product page where applicable.
refund_non_returnable_2: Nothing in this section limits any mandatory consumer rights that cannot legally be excluded.
refund_damaged_1: If you receive a product that is damaged, defective, materially different from its description, or not the product you ordered, please contact us as soon as reasonably possible.
refund_damaged_2: We may ask you to provide photographs, order details, or other information needed to review the issue. Depending on the circumstances, we may offer a replacement, return, partial refund, or full refund.
refund_cancellation_1: Customers may request cancellation before an order has been processed or shipped. We will make reasonable efforts to cancel an order when possible, but cancellation cannot be guaranteed once processing or fulfillment has begun.
refund_cancellation_2: If an order cannot be cancelled before shipment, the customer may need to follow the applicable return procedure after receiving the order.
refund_request_title: 6. How to Request a Return or Refund
refund_request_1: To request a cancellation, return, replacement, or refund, contact our customer support team and provide the information necessary to identify the order and review the request.
refund_request_2: Please include your order number, the email address used for the order, the product concerned, and a brief explanation of the issue.
refund_request_3: Where a return is required, customers should follow the return instructions provided by Malidag. Products should not be returned to an address unless return instructions have first been provided.
refund_shipping_1: Responsibility for return shipping costs depends on the reason for the return, the applicable product terms, and any mandatory consumer rights.
refund_shipping_2: Where a return results from an incorrect, damaged, or defective product for which Malidag is responsible, applicable return shipping costs may be covered or reimbursed where required.
refund_shipping_3: For other eligible returns, the customer may be responsible for return shipping costs unless otherwise stated or required by applicable law.
refund_processing_1: Once a refund request has been approved, the refund will generally be issued to the original payment method used for the purchase unless another method is required or agreed.
refund_processing_2: We aim to initiate approved refunds within 5 to 10 business days after the refund is approved or, where a returned product must first be received and inspected, after that process is completed.
refund_processing_3: After a refund is issued, additional processing time may be required by the customer's bank, card issuer, or payment service provider before the funds appear in the customer's account.
refund_partial_1: In appropriate circumstances, a partial refund may be offered instead of a full refund, including where only part of an order is affected or where the customer agrees to keep a product with a documented issue.
refund_not_received_1: If an order has not arrived within the expected delivery period, please contact customer support so that we can review the shipment status.
refund_not_received_2: Depending on the circumstances, including carrier information and the outcome of the delivery review, an appropriate resolution may include continued delivery support, replacement, or refund.
refund_unfulfilled_title: 11. Refunds for Cancelled or Unfulfilled Orders
refund_unfulfilled_1: If Malidag cancels an order after payment has been collected because the order cannot be fulfilled, the amount paid for the affected order or product will be refunded.
refund_late_1: If you have been notified that a refund was issued but have not received it, please first allow time for your bank or payment service provider to complete its processing.
refund_late_2: If the refund still does not appear after a reasonable processing period, please contact us so that we can review the transaction.
refund_rights_1: This policy does not limit any rights or remedies that customers may have under mandatory consumer protection laws applicable to their purchase.
refund_contact_1: If you have questions about a cancellation, return, replacement, or refund, please contact our customer support team.
faq_intro: Find answers to common questions about shopping on Malidag, payments, orders, delivery, returns, refunds, and customer support.
faq_what_is_malidag_1: Malidag is an online shopping platform offering products across categories including fashion, electronics, beauty, home, and lifestyle. Product availability may vary depending on the customer's delivery country.
faq_account_title: 2. Do I need an account to place an order?
faq_account_1: Some features may require a customer account. Where account creation is required, you will be asked to provide the information necessary to create and manage your account.
faq_payment_methods_1: Available payment methods are shown during checkout. Depending on your location and the order, available options may include credit cards, debit cards, and other supported payment methods.
faq_payment_security_1: Payments may be processed by third-party payment service providers. These providers use their own security systems and procedures to process payment information.
faq_payment_security_2: Malidag may receive limited payment-related information such as payment status, transaction identifiers, and information needed to process or support an order.
faq_prices_country_title: 5. Can product prices vary by country?
faq_prices_country_1: Yes. Product prices, available products, shipping charges, taxes, duties, and other applicable charges may vary depending on the delivery country and order.
faq_order_success_title: 6. How do I know if my order was placed successfully?
faq_order_success_1: After an order is successfully submitted, you should receive an order confirmation or see confirmation through the Malidag order process. Keep your order information for future reference.
faq_cancel_order_1: You may request cancellation before your order has been processed or shipped. We will make reasonable efforts to cancel the order when possible, but cancellation cannot be guaranteed once processing or fulfillment has begun.
faq_delivery_locations_1: Malidag delivers to supported destinations. Available products, delivery methods, shipping charges, and estimated delivery times may vary by destination and order.
faq_delivery_time_1: Estimated delivery times depend on the destination, product, fulfillment process, and carrier. Delivery estimates are provided where available during the shopping or checkout process.
faq_delivery_time_2: Delivery times may be affected by carriers, customs procedures, holidays, local conditions, or other circumstances outside our reasonable control.
faq_tracking_title: 10. How can I track my order?
faq_tracking_1: If tracking information is available for your shipment, it may be provided after the order has been processed or shipped. The availability and detail of tracking information may depend on the carrier and destination.
faq_order_not_arrived_title: 11. What should I do if my order has not arrived?
faq_order_not_arrived_1: If your order has not arrived within the expected delivery period, please contact customer support with your order information so that we can review the shipment status.
faq_damaged_product_title: 12. What should I do if I receive a damaged or incorrect product?
faq_damaged_product_1: Please contact us as soon as reasonably possible if a product arrives damaged, defective, materially different from its description, or is not the product you ordered.
faq_damaged_product_2: We may ask for photographs, order details, or other information necessary to review the issue and determine the appropriate resolution.
faq_return_product_1: Eligible products may be returned in accordance with our Return and Refund Policy. Unless otherwise stated or required by applicable law, customers should contact us within 14 days of receiving an order if they wish to request a return.
faq_all_returnable_1: No. Certain products may not be eligible for return for reasons such as hygiene, safety, personalization, perishability, or other lawful restrictions. Any applicable product-specific restrictions should be shown on the product page where appropriate.
faq_refund_processing_1: Once a refund has been approved, it will generally be issued to the original payment method unless another method is required or agreed.
faq_refund_processing_2: We aim to initiate approved refunds within 5 to 10 business days after approval or, where a returned product must first be received and inspected, after that process is completed.
faq_refund_missing_title: 16. Why has my refund not appeared yet?
faq_refund_missing_1: After a refund is issued, your bank, card issuer, or payment service provider may require additional processing time before the funds appear in your account.
faq_refund_missing_2: If the refund does not appear after a reasonable processing period, please contact us so that we can review the transaction.
faq_customs_title: 17. Will I have to pay customs duties or import taxes?
faq_customs_1: International orders may be subject to customs duties, import taxes, fees, or other charges imposed by local authorities. Any applicable responsibilities depend on local law and the information provided during checkout or delivery.
faq_unavailable_country_title: 18. Why is a product unavailable in my country?
faq_unavailable_country_1: Product availability may depend on the delivery destination, inventory, supplier availability, shipping restrictions, or other operational requirements.
faq_contact_1: If you need help with a product, order, payment, delivery, return, refund, or account, please contact our customer support team.

search_info_title: Learn more about your search results
search_info_intro: Learn how Malidag uses your search to find and display relevant products.
search_info_how_description: When you search on Malidag, we may normalize your search so it can be matched consistently with product information in our catalog.
search_info_match_description: We compare your search with available product information. This may include:
search_info_country_description: Search results are limited according to the country currently selected on Malidag. A product that is available in one country may not appear in another.
search_info_results_description: The products shown are products that matched the search term and the availability requirements for your selected country.
search_info_change_description: Search results may change as products are added, removed, updated, or become available or unavailable in your selected country.

new_deals_every_day: New deals are added every day. Try another country or check back soon.
intl_ship_desc: Learn how shipping and product availability work on Malidag. We currently support France, the United Kingdom, and Brazil, with more countries planned.
shipping_intro: Malidag is building international shopping country by country. We currently support shipping for available products in France, the United Kingdom, and Brazil, and we are working to expand to additional countries.
shipping_current_countries_text: Malidag currently supports shopping and shipping for available products in the following countries:
shipping_country_selection_note: The country you select on Malidag helps determine which products are shown as available for your market.
shipping_how_it_works_p1: Malidag does not display exactly the same product catalog in every country. Product availability is determined according to the country you select and the shipping availability currently supported for that market.
shipping_how_it_works_p2: Products that are not currently available for your selected country may not appear in the catalog. This helps us avoid presenting a product as available when its delivery cannot currently be supported for that market.
shipping_availability_title: Why availability can differ between brands and products
shipping_availability_p1: Not every product or brand becomes available in every supported country at the same time. Availability can depend on the location of the brand or its products, the markets in which the brand operates, and the shipping options available for a particular destination.
shipping_availability_p2: Some brands may already be present in your country or have suitable distribution and shipping options there. As a result, products from those brands may become available earlier than products from other brands.
shipping_availability_example: For example, a product may already be available to customers in France while the same product is not yet available in Brazil or the United Kingdom. The opposite can also happen depending on the brand and product location.
shipping_expansion_p1: We are working on extending Malidag to additional countries. Expansion happens gradually, and the availability of individual brands and products may also increase over time within each market.
shipping_expansion_box_title: New countries and products may arrive at different times
shipping_expansion_box_text: Supporting a new country does not necessarily mean that every Malidag product will immediately be available there. Some brands and products may become available earlier than others.
shipping_delivery_p1: Delivery times can vary depending on the product, brand, product location, destination, and the shipping method available for that order.
shipping_delivery_p2: Because products on Malidag may come from different brands and locations, two products may have different delivery timeframes. Where available, relevant delivery information is shown during the shopping or checkout process.
shipping_cost_p1: Shipping costs can vary depending on the product, destination, package, and available shipping method. Where applicable, the shipping cost is shown before you complete your purchase.
shipping_customs_p1: Depending on the product, its origin, and the destination, an order may be subject to customs duties, import taxes, or other charges required by local authorities. Where these charges apply, they may be separate from the product and shipping price.
Need_Help_part2: if you have questions about shipping or product availability.
